t: The Signature Driver: Indexed Bit Collar
title: The Signature Driver: Indexed Bit Collar
description: The Signature driver's handle has an indexed bit collar — twist to the detent marked P1, P2, T10 and the matching bit presents from the magazine. No more digging through a 64-bit case for the one bit: the collar is the index. The six most-used PC bits live in the handle; the full kit stays on the bench for the exotic ones.

demo.program:
collar = ["P2", "P1", "P0", "T10", "HEX2.5", "FLAT"]
print("Indexed collar: twist to detent -> bit presents.")
for c in collar:
    print(f"  [{c}]")
print("6 most-used bits in handle; full kit on bench for exotics.")

t: Signature Bit Magazine: Six Bits, Zero Digging
title: Signature Bit Magazine: Six Bits, Zero Digging
description: The handle's magazine holds six bits in spring-loaded slots, each slot labeled and each bit returning to its slot with a click. The slots are the inventory — an empty slot is visible instantly, so the slot check takes one glance. The magazine swaps as a unit: a Torx-heavy job gets the Torx magazine, a Phillips job the Phillips magazine.

demo.program:
print("6 spring slots, labeled, click-return. Empty slot = visible instantly.")
print("Magazines swap as units: Torx mag for GPU jobs, Phillips mag for case jobs.")
print("Slot check: one glance. The magazine IS the inventory.")

title: Signature Torque-Limiting Clutch
description: The Signature handle has a torque-limiting clutch with three detents — delicate (M.2/small), standard (board/drive), firm (case/PSU) — that slips before the screw strips. Set it to the fastener, not the job, and over-torque becomes nearly impossible. It is the mechanical version of experienced hands, built into the handle.

demo.program:
clutch = ["delicate: M.2, small brackets", "standard: board, drives", "firm: case, PSU"]
for c in clutch:
    print(f"  - {c}")
print("Clutch slips before strip: set to FASTENER, not job.")

title: Signature End-Cap Pressure System
description: The rotating end cap has a pressure spring calibrated so proper press-and-turn force feels like a soft click — press until the click, then turn. Beginners learn correct pressure by feel in minutes instead of by stripped screws over months. The cap's knurling also works as a finger spinner for fast rundown of long screws.

print("Beginners learn pressure by feel in minutes, not by stripped screws.")
print("Knurled cap doubles as finger spinner for long screws.")

t: Signature Bit Steel and Wear Indicators
title: Signature Bit Steel and Wear Indicators
description: Signature bits are S2 steel with a wear-indicator band: when the band wears through at the tip, the bit is done — no guessing whether a bit is 'still okay'. Worn bits get retired to beater duty automatically because the indicator makes the call. Individual replacement bits come in 3-packs of the high-wear sizes (P1, P2).

demo.program:
print("S2 bits + wear-indicator band: band gone at tip = bit retired.")
print("The indicator makes the call: no 'still okay' guessing.")
print("Replacements: 3-packs of P1/P2 (the high-wear sizes).")

title: Signature Magnetic Field Control
description: The Signature holder's magnet slides: forward for full retention (positioning tiny screws), back for reduced field (working near filings or sensitive spots). A detent marks each position. Field control means the driver is magnetic exactly when you want it and clean when you do not — instead of always-on magnets collecting debris.

demo.program:
print("Sliding magnet: FORWARD = full retention (tiny screws), BACK = reduced field.")
print("Magnetic exactly when wanted, clean when not.")
print("Always-on magnets collect debris; controlled magnets don't.")

title: Signature vs Standard Precision Sets
description: A standard set is a handle plus a case of loose bits you dig through. The Signature driver indexes six bits in the handle, limits torque by detent, teaches pressure with a click, shows bit wear with a band, and controls its magnet with a slide. Same screws, same physics — the Signature removes the digging, the stripping, the guessing, and the debris.

print("Standard: handle + loose bits to dig through, skill-stopped stripping.")
print("Signature: indexed bits, clutch detents, click pressure, wear bands, field slide.")
print("Removes: digging, stripping, guessing, debris.")

t: Signature Bit Subscription: Never a Worn Bit

title: Signature Maintenance and Calibration
description: The Signature schedule: wipe bits after jobs, check clutch detents quarterly (they should click positively), inspect wear bands monthly on daily drivers, demagnetize slider monthly. The clutch is user-calibratable with the included key — five minutes, documented on the station card. A maintained Signature driver outlives three disposable sets.

print("Quarterly: clutch detents (must click positive).")
print("Clutch user-calibratable (5 min, on station card). Outlives 3 disposables.")
